senses.en_definition: To recognize someone or something from having seen, heard, or encountered them before.
To know someone through personal contact or acquaintance.

collocations.en: have known each other since childhood

senses.en_definition: In kenal huruf, to recognize letters and have basic reading skills.

collocations.en: recognize letters; be able to read

messages.en: Do you know the boy next to Faris in that photo? I feel like I've seen him before.
Yeah, he's a friend of my younger sibling's. He used to come over a lot.
Oh, that explains it! I must've met him at your place.
Look at this photo. It brings back so many memories of our school days.
Doesn't it? I want to save this photo. Such lovely memories.

senses.en_definition: Why; used to ask the reason for something or to ask what is wrong.

messages.en: Why so quiet? Have you gone to sleep already?
Not yet. Mum called me earlier, and I left my phone in my room. I've only just seen your message.
I'm just going for a pee. Wait here a sec.
Okay, the toilet's down at the far end. I'll wait here.
